paite: Huchi in Abijah bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, David khopi ah avui ua, asik in atapa Asa in vai ahawmta hi. Avaihawm sung in agam uh kum sawm galmuang in a-om hi.
heading: Kumpipa Asa In Ethiopiate Azou

paite: Asa in TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih leh thil dik ahih gige hi.
Gamdang pathian maitamte leh mun sangte alamang a, suangphuhte ahihchim a, Asherah songte aphuk hi.
Judahte TOUPA apipute uh Pathian zong ding leh adan leh athupiak zui ding in thu apia hi.
Huan Judahte khua tengteng a mun sangte leh milimte alamang vek a; amah nuai ah agam galmuang in a-om hi.
Judah gam ah kulh nei khopite abawl a, gam galmuang in a-om a, huai kumte in kidouna anei kei; TOUPA'N galmuanna apiak ziak in.

Judahte kiang ah, "Hiai khuate bawlpha nawn ni e, kulh in um lehang, insangte, kulh kongkhakte, akalhnate bawl ni: TOUPA i Pathian i zon tak ziak un gam i nuai uah ahong omta ahi: amah i zong ua, ama'n kil chih ning chih a galmuang a omna hon peta ahi,” achi hi. Huchi in abawlhoih ua, alamzang zelta uhi.
Asa in Judah mi lum leh tei tawimi sepaih nuaithum anei a: Benjamin mi phaw leh thal zangmi nuainih-le-singgiat; hiai tengteng mihat hangsan vek ahi uhi.
Huan Ethiopia mi Zerah, sepaih maktaduaikhat leh kangtalai zathum toh amau sual ding in ahong kuan a; Mareshah ahong tung hi.
Huchi in asual ding in Asa ava kuan a, Mareshah ah Zephathah Phaizang ah akiphalh uhi.

Asa in TOUPA a Pathian asam a, "TOUPA kia lou ngal mihattak lak a hat lou panpih a-om kei a; aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, hon panpih ve; nang hon muang in na min in hiai mipite ka hong sual uhi. Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian uh na hi a, mihing in nang hon zou kei uhen,” achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Asa leh Judahte ma ah Ethiopia mite asual a; Ethiopia mite ataikekta uhi.
Asa leh aheute'n Gerar tan in adelh ua, Ethiopia mite asih tam mahmah ziak un apang thei kei ua; TOUPA leh asepaihte ma ah vuallelhsak in a-omta ua; gallak tampi ala uhi.
Gerar kim a khua tengteng asual ua, TOUPA launa atung uah a-om a, khua tengteng alok ua, gallak atam ngial hi.
Ganpute' puaninte leng asual ua, belam leh sangawngsau tampi ahawl ua, Jerusalem ah apai nawnta uhi.
